claims.evidence: The weight stamp is not visible in any photo.

risks.risk: The cylinder may be expired or past its re-test date.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the manufacture or expiry date stamp on the handle or collar.

risks.risk: The valve may be leaking or the burner may not ignite.
risks.proof: A video showing the valve being opened and the burner lit.

risks.risk: The cylinder may be empty or contain a different gas than LPG.
risks.proof: A photo of the weight stamp and a video of the cylinder being weighed.

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
Photo of the weight stamp (usually on the handle or collar) to confirm 6kg.
Photo of the manufacture or expiry date stamp.
Video of the valve being opened and the burner lit.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
